test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 15 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following Indian states has minimum area?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Uttar Pradesh** is one of the northern states of India.
 
• It is the most populous state in India, with over 200 million inhabitants.
 
• The state has a significant cultural heritage, with cities like Agra and Varanasi being major cultural centers.
 
• Despite its large population, **Uttar Pradesh** has a smaller geographical area compared to states like Rajasthan, Maharashtra, and Madhya Pradesh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rajasthan:**

 
 
• Rajasthan is the largest state in India by area.
 
• It is located in the northwestern part of India.
 
• Known for its desert landscapes and vibrant culture.
 
 
 
• **Maharashtra:**
 
 
• Maharashtra is the second-most populous state in India.
 
• It is located in the western part of India.
 
• Home to Mumbai, the financial capital of India.
 
 
 
• **Uttar Pradesh:**
 
 
• Uttar Pradesh is the fourth largest state in India by area.
 
• Located in the northern part of India.
 
• Known for its historical and religious significance.
 
 
 
• **Madhya Pradesh:**
 
 
• Madhya Pradesh is the second-largest state in India by area.
 
• It is located in the central part of India.
 
• Known as the "Heart of India" due to its geographical location.
